nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _balances holding token balances of every account including burn and reward addresses
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowed holding ERC20 allowances
uint256 _totalSupply, mutated by burn logic and read in findPercent to compute reward/burn rate
uint256 public basePercent = 500, unused base rate constant exposed publicly
payable constructor that sets token metadata and mints the initial 490e18 supply to msg.sender
public transfer(address to, uint256 value) that burns and rewards a computed percent of the value on every call
public transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) moves tokens using allowance and applies burn/reward accounting
public multiTransfer(address[] receivers, uint256[] amounts) loops and delegates to transfer without length validation
public approve(address spender, uint256 value) writes _allowed[msg.sender][spender] with no allowance-increase race protection
public increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) adds to the caller's allowance
public decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) subtracts from the caller's allowance via SafeMath.sub
internal _mint(address account, uint256 amount) increases the account balance but does not increase _totalSupply
external burn(uint256 amount) that delegates to _burn(msg.sender, amount)
internal _burn(address account, uint256 amount) reduces _totalSupply and the account balance
external burnFrom(address account, uint256 amount) consumes allowance and burns from another account
public view findPercent(uint256 value) computes a burn/reward percentage that depends on the current _totalSupply tier
public view totalSupply returning _totalSupply
public view balanceOf(address owner) returning _balances[owner]
public view allowance(address owner, address spender) returning _allowed[owner][spender]
msg.sender, untrusted caller used as the debit account and allowance owner in transfer/approve/transferFrom/burn paths

transfer() mutates _balances[msg.sender], _balances[to], the burn address and the fixed reward address plus _totalSupply in a single flow; reward tokens are credited without being deducted anywhere, breaking supply accounting
transferFrom() debits _balances[from], credits to/burn/reward balances and reduces the allowance, all before emitting events, with debit ordering that trusts the caller supplied spender allowance
_burn() reduces _totalSupply and the account balance based on an externally supplied amount

parameter owner of allowance(address owner, address spender)
parameter spender of allowance(address owner, address spender)
parameter to of transfer(address to, uint256 value), the recipient of tokens
parameter value of transfer(address to, uint256 value), the amount the caller moves
parameter from of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value), the debited account
parameter to of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value)
parameter value of transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value)
parameter receivers array of multiTransfer(address[] receivers, uint256[] amounts)
parameter amounts array of multiTransfer(address[] receivers, uint256[] amounts)
parameter spender of approve(address spender, uint256 value)
parameter value of approve(address spender, uint256 value)
parameter spender of increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue)
parameter addedValue of increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue)
parameter spender of decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue)
parameter subtractedValue of decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue)
parameter account of _mint(address account, uint256 amount)
parameter amount of _mint(address account, uint256 amount)
parameter amount of burn(uint256 amount)
parameter account of _burn(address account, uint256 amount)
parameter amount of _burn(address account, uint256 amount)
parameter account of burnFrom(address account, uint256 amount)
parameter amount of burnFrom(address account, uint256 amount)
parameter value of findPercent(uint256 value), the base amount the percentage is computed from
local uint256 percent in findPercent, selected from the _totalSupply tier branches
local uint256 tokensToBurn in transfer, amount removed from supply
local uint256 tokensToReward in transfer, amount credited to the fixed reward address without a matching debit
local uint256 tokensToTransfer in transfer = value.sub(tokensToBurn.add(tokensToReward))
local uint256 tokensToBurn in transferFrom, amount removed from supply
local uint256 tokensToReward in transferFrom, credited to the reward address
local uint256 tokensToTransfer in transferFrom computed with SafeMath sub/add
local uint256 i loop counter in multiTransfer

edges.reason: owner parameter indexes _balances in balanceOf

spender parameter indexes the allowance lookup

allowance reads _allowed for owner and spender
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply state variable

transferFrom from parameter selects the debited balance
transferFrom to parameter selects the credited balance
transferFrom value parameter drives debit, burn, reward and allowance reduction
receivers array elements are passed to transfer as the recipient
amounts array elements are passed to transfer as the value, with no array length check
user supplied spender receives an arbitrary allowance from the caller

spender parameter is the allowance target of decreaseAllowance

amount parameter is SafeMath.add-ed to the balance but never added to _totalSupply
burn amount parameter is forwarded to _burn with msg.sender
account parameter selects the balance reduced in _burn
amount parameter is SafeMath.sub-ed from _totalSupply and from _balances[account]

amount parameter is checked against and subtracted from the allowance
value parameter is the base for the tiered percentage computation
findPercent branches on the mutable _totalSupply, so burn/reward rate depends on live supply state
percent local is produced by the _totalSupply tier branches
percent is divided by two and assigned to tokensToBurn
the identical percent is reused as tokensToReward, minting a reward twice the intended rate
value.sub(tokensToBurn.add(tokensToReward)) can revert when burn plus reward exceeds value
tokensToBurn is subtracted from value to derive the transferred amount
tokensToReward is subtracted from value to derive the transferred amount
transfer calls findPercent twice, once for burn and once for reward
transferFrom calls findPercent twice for burn and reward computation
